# Resonate Website LLM Policy & Architecture

Resonate is an open-source social voice platform, and this is its landing page built on Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4 under the AOSSIE organization. It features multi-language support (`next-intl`), smooth scrolling (`lenis`), dynamic theme management (`next-themes`), and static export capabilities (`output: 'export'`).

---

## 📂 Project Architecture

- **`src/app/[locale]/`**: Localized dynamic route group containing pages, layouts, and global styles.
- **`src/app/sitemap.ts`**: Dynamically generates localized sitemap entries.
- **`public/brand/`**: Contains official Resonate & AOSSIE vector logos, favicons, and brand guidelines (`Brand.md`).
- **`src/config/languages.ts`**: Central registry of supported languages and default locale (`en`).
- **`src/i18n/`**: Localization routing setups, request handlers, and navigation helpers (`navigation.ts`).
- **`src/messages/`**: Translation catalogs (`en.json`, `hi.json`).
- **`src/components/`**: Modular UI components (Navbar, Footer, Hero, About, Metric, Features, LanguageSwitcher, ThemeToggle).

---

## 🎨 Theme & Styling Guidelines

- Class-based dark mode configured via Tailwind CSS v4 `@custom-variant dark`.
- Semantic CSS variables (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`) are bound in `globals.css`.
- Avoid inline dark utilities; use semantic token classes.

---

## 📦 Build & Runtime Commands

- **Build:** `npm run build` (Static export into `./out`)
- **Develop:** `npm run dev`
- **Lint:** `npm run lint`
- **Test:** `npm run test`
